transferable_lessons: Acquisition creative may be visually rich when ONE headline dominates and every other block is subordinate and organised (benefit rows, step band)

The same concept may ship in two colour treatments within one campaign
A representative person may appear in GENERIC acquisition/brand creative when disclosed as representative and never presented as a specific customer or a testimonial
Landscape 6:5 acquisition layout with no band is acceptable when the logo is large and the CTA is unmistakable
Blue panels as a corner device are acceptable in blue-accent treatments
An exterior with staged merchandise is an acceptable environmental treatment for GENERIC estate creative (a real event uses its real photographs)
Category icon rows may name what buyers will find
CENTERED messaging is a valid professional-seller structure; the reference system must carry a RANGE (centered, asymmetric, environmental, merchandise-led)
